'''Cream''' was a food product. [[Zoochberry cream/Legends|Zoochberry cream]] was made of [[Zoochberry/Legends|zoochberries]] and was served alongside [[Whaladon/Legends|Whaladon]] meat at a meeting of the [[Central Committee of Grand Moffs]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]<ref name="Glove" /> in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].<ref name="Readers">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[The Glove of Darth Vader]]'' in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref>
